description_en: Queries the number of protected resources that are associated with one or more protection templates
description_zh: 查询防护模板生效的防护资源个数
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-template-resource-count --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-lbj0000gx08 --template-ids 12345,12346 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeTemplateResourceCount

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html，查看当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of protection templates. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的多个防护模板ID。您可以设置该参数，查询多个已创建的防护模板生效的防护资源，多个防护模板ID之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: template_ids

parameters.help_en:
The region in which the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

ResourceCount.description_en: An array of resource count objects. Each object contains the number of protected objects, protected object groups, and protected assets that are associated with a protection template
ResourceCount.description_zh: 防护模板生效的防护对象、防护对象组或防护资产个数

items.description_en: The resource count details for a protection template, including the number of protected objects, protected object groups, and protected assets
items.description_zh: 防护模板生效的防护对象、防护对象组或防护资产

AssetCount.description_en: The number of protected assets that are associated with the protection template

GroupCount.description_en: The number of protected object groups that are associated with the protection template

SingleCount.description_en: The number of protected objects that are associated with the protection template

TemplateId.description_en: The ID of the protection template
